· Partner with division finance teams to understand external and internal business dynamics and their impact on results

· Develop sustainable content for use in monthly business reviews (MBRs) and provide ad-hoc financial analytics and deep dives to facilitate decision making

· Partner with broader stakeholders to drive critical reporting needs and capabilities

Preferred Qualifications:

· Financial planning and analysis experience

· Ability to translate financial analysis into insights and action plans

· Ability to identify key metrics critical to business performance and provide easily understood and actionable management reporting

· Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills

· Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to interact with senior management

· Strong presentation skills to communicate complex financial and performance information with a variety of audiences, including those with limited finance background

· Self-motivated with ability to efficiently organize and prioritize competing priorities

· Demonstrated attention to detail and ability to develop, implement and interpret financial models

· Strong PC and systems skills (Power BI, Microsoft Excel, Access, and PowerPoint) Excel, Access and PowerPoint)

Job Details

Role Summary

The Analyst, FP&A is a core member of the FP&A team supporting the organization, The role owns the monthly reporting rhythm: loading and validating KPI data, managing the month-end process in Vena, and preparing the financial review deck for leadership. Alongside this, the analyst supports budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis and ad hoc analysis, and helps document FP&A processes so they are repeatable and transferable.

Key Responsibilities

Monthly KPI Uploads Collect, validate and upload monthly KPI and operational data to the reporting/planning platform per the close calendar.

Maintain KPI definitions, data sources and upload checklists to ensure accuracy and consistency month to month.

Conduct trend analysis on the KPI drivers loaded each month, and flag anomalies and notable movements to FP&A leaders.

Vena Month-End Process Management

Manage month-end activities in Vena: actuals loads, mapping and validation checks, templates, workflow/task tracking and sign-offs.

Monitor the close timeline, follow up with contributors, and escalate open items so deliverables land on schedule.

Troubleshoot data, mapping and template issues; partner with system administrators on enhancements and fixes.

Monthly Financial Review Deck (Supporting Role)

Prepare the first draft of the monthly financial review deck: actuals vs. budget, forecast and prior year, with KPI trends and key drivers.

Hand off the draft to the team, who add commentary and finalize it for business reviews; incorporate feedback and updates.

Turn analysis into clean, executive-ready charts and tables; manage version control and meet draft deadlines.

Planning, Forecasting & Analysis (Supporting Role)

Support the FP&A team during budget, forecast and long-range planning cycles by preparing inputs, updating models and consolidating data.

Assist with variance, trend and driver-based analysis versus plan, forecast and prior periods.

Support scenario analysis, business cases and ROI analysis as directed by senior team members.

Assist in analyzing KPIs and underlying business drivers to help surface insights.

Help document assumptions, inputs and forecast drivers to support consistency and transparency.

Work with Accounting and cross-functional teams to help ensure financial data integrity.

Support ad hoc analysis and reports as needed; perform related duties as assigned.

Process Documentation & Continuous Improvement

Assist in documenting FP&A processes (month-end steps, KPI upload procedures, deck production, Vena workflows) as step-by-step guides and checklists.

Keep documentation current as processes and systems change; support cross-training and handoffs.

Identify opportunities to automate or streamline recurring reporting and flag them to the team.

Technical Skills

Required: advanced Microsoft Excel (financial modeling, pivot tables, lookups, SUMIFS, data validation); Microsoft PowerPoint for executive reporting.

Preferred: fundamental accounting and FP&A knowledge.

Good to have: working with AI tools to improve processes and assist in analyses.

Core Competencies
• Strong attention to detail and a high standard of accuracy.
• Excellent analytical, organizational and time-management skills; reliably meets month-end deadlines.
• Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining numbers to non-finance audiences.
• Discretion with confidential information.
• Curious, proactive and comfortable working with partners across time zones.

Job Description

Position – Senior Manager - Finance (Global GL controllership)

Work Location: Pune (All days Work from office)

Reporting to: Associate Director (Finance)

Qualification

· Chartered Accountant (CA)

· 10 to 12 years of post-qualification experience in Financial Reporting, Consolidation, Controllership, and Audit

· Experience in US GAAP/IFRS reporting and group consolidation is mandatory

· IT/ITES or Tech industry experience will be preferred

· Exposure to SOX compliance and multinational environments will be preferred

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Manager - Finance to support the Global Controllership function. The role will be responsible for monthly books close, variance analysis, US GAAP reporting, SOX compliance, and coordination with global finance teams. The candidate will play a critical role in ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting to adhere management reporting timelines.

Key Responsibilities

· Conduct monthly variance analysis of Profit & Loss accounts and Balance Sheet items.

· Coordinate with finance teams across subsidiaries to obtain financial information and resolve reporting issues.

· Participate in monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes in compliance with US GAAP requirements.

· Participate in the intercompany workings related to cost plus, agency revenue, common cost allocation etc.

· Review journal entries, accruals, intercompany transactions, and balance sheet reconciliations.

· Perform detailed General Ledger scrutiny and ensure completeness and accuracy of accounting records.

· Review and validate US GAAP adjustment workings, including:

o Lease accounting

o Compensated absences

o Defined benefit obligations

o Term loan

o Other technical accounting adjustments

· Support financial close activities of newly acquired entities.

· Coordinate with acquired entity finance teams to ensure smooth integration into group reporting processes.

· Monitor SOX controls related to financial reporting and month-end close processes.

· Assist in remediation and resolution of control deficiencies, if any.

· Support group auditors and management by preparing audit schedules, reconciliations, and financial analysis.

· Lead and coordinate local statutory and compliance audits for subsidiaries.

· Participate in finance transformation initiatives and system enhancement projects.

· Contribute to strengthening the overall finance control environment.

Skills & Competencies

· Strong understanding of US GAAP/IFRS and financial consolidation principles.

· Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

· Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and SAP/Oracle systems.

· Effective stakeholder management and communication skills.

· High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

Work Location: Hinjewadi, Pune, Maharashtra.

Pay: ₹200,000.00 - ₹250,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

JOB DESCRIPTION

Head Finance & Accounts | Chartered Accountant (CA)

1. POSITION SUMMARY

Position TitleHead Finance & Accounts Also Referred AsChartered Accountant (CA) / HOD Finance & AccountsDepartmentFinance & AccountsIndustryManufacturing (100% Export Unit to USA)Reporting ToCEOLocationPune (Talegaon Dabhade MIDC Near Hyundai Motors Company)Nature of RoleIndividual-contributor-cum-leadership role (strategic oversight + hands-on execution)Experience5 to 7 years post-qualification (Pref. CA Batch 20192021)

At least 4 years of working experience in the manufacturing industryCompensation (CTC)15,00,000 20,00,000 per annumLanguagesFluent in written and spoken English and HindiTravelShould be able to travel within India and abroad2. POSITION OVERVIEW

We are looking for a dynamic, highly skilled, independent and hands-on Head of Finance & Accounts to lead our Finance & Accounts department. The ideal candidate has to take complete ownership of day-to-day manufacturing accounting, rigorous statutory compliances, complex Import-Export (EXIM), customs and trade regulations, and financial reporting.

This is an individual-contributor-cum-leadership role that demands a unique combination of high-level strategic financial leadership and the ability to independently execute core ground-level accounting functions transitioning seamlessly from strategic tracking to ledger entries with minimal supervision and in concurrence with the Companys policies.

3. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

A. Core Accounting, Plant Costing & Financial Finalisation

End-to-End Accounting: Supervise and independently execute all primary bookkeeping, journal entries and general ledger maintenance.

Financial Finalisation: Prepare, review and finalise monthly, quarterly and annual Trial Balances, Profit & Loss (P&L) Statements, Balance Sheets and Cash Flow Statements; prepare full sets of accounting reports including financial budget and annual forecast.

¢ Inventory Control: Monitor inventory valuation, tracking and aging to minimise holding costs and discrepancies.

B. MIS, Budgeting, Forecasting & Financial Analysis

¢ MIS Reporting: Report monthly Management Information System (MIS) reports to the Board / management.

¢ Projections & Cash Flow: Prepare fund-flow tracking, rolling cash flow forecasts and financial projection statements.

¢ Financial Analysis: Analyse financial statements; forecast financial trends and their impact on future activities.

C. Working Capital, Receivables & Payables

¢ Receivables & Payables Management: Monitor and manage Accounts Receivable (AR) and Accounts Payable (AP); conduct age analysis (aging reports).

D. Taxation & Statutory Compliance (Direct & Indirect)

¢ GST: Independently handle monthly, quarterly and annual GSTR filings (GSTR-1, 3B, 9/9C); E-way bills; maintain e-invoicing workflows and cross-verify e-invoices; manage the GST Refund Tracker to optimise Input Tax Credit (ITC) and protect cash flows.

¢ TDS / TCS: Oversee monthly TDS / TCS deductions, accurate and timely deposits, and quarterly TDS return filings, including TRACES.

¢ Income Tax: Manage advance tax planning, corporate income tax provisions, Tax Audit and Income Tax Returns.

¢ Salary & Wages-related Provisions & Filings: PF / ESI filings; Gratuity & Bonus provisions.

¢ Corporate & Legal Compliance: Assist the Company Secretary (CS) in Corporate & Legal Compliance (MCA / ROC).

E. Audit, Internal Controls & Reconciliations

¢ Audit Ownership: Lead and prepare all required documentation / schedules for Statutory Audits and Tax Audits.

¢ Internal Financial Controls: Lead Internal Financial Controls (IFC) assessments.

¢ Reconciliations: Execute rigorous, error-free monthly bank, vendor and internal accounts ledger reconciliations, and Input Tax Credit (ITC) reconciliations.

K. Corporate Assessments & Litigation

¢ Income Tax, TDS & GST Notices: Draft replies, handle online submissions, prepare data for assessments or departmental audits, and represent the Company before the departments for basic notices.

L. Team Leadership & Systems

¢ Team Supervision: Supervise and lead the accounting staff.

¢ ERP Administration: Operate and administer ERP software, including user rights, utilities and reports.

4. CANDIDATE PROFILE & QUALIFICATIONS

Educational & Professional Background

¢ Mandatory: Chartered Accountant (ICAI Member); university post-graduate with CA, MBA (Finance).

¢ Experience: At least 68 years of working experience in the manufacturing industry, with proven experience in supervising other accounting staff.

¢ Industry Preference: Experience in manufacturing, trading, or businesses with heavy import / export operations is highly preferred; preference for candidates with experience in Import and Export transactions.

Knowledge

¢ Full understanding of accounting regulations and legal aspects applicable in India.

¢ Deep understanding of factory accounting, inventory management and cross-border trade mechanics.

¢ Trade Knowledge: Sharp grasp of FEMA guidelines, customs regulations and DGFT licensing systems.

Skills & Tools

¢ Software: Advanced proficiency in ERP systems (Tally Prime, SAP or Oracle) and expert-level MS Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, complex formulas, financial modelling).

¢ Working Ability: Able to work independently, with minimal supervision, in concurrence with the Companys policies.

¢ Execution Style: Hands-on; transitions seamlessly from high-level strategic tracking to ground-level ledger entries.

5. OTHER REQUIREMENTS

¢ Languages: Fluent in written and spoken English and Hindi.

¢ Travel: Should be able to travel within India and abroad.
